errors.premium_required: This question belongs to a premium practice set. An active premium package for the course is required.
errors.no_matching_questions: No questions match these filters. Try fewer filters or other courses.
errors.no_courses: Enrol in a course (or choose courses) to practise.
errors.attempt_paused: The attempt is paused. Resume it to keep answering.
errors.pause_not_allowed: This assessment does not allow pausing, or the pause budget is used up.
errors.exposure_limit_reached: You have already seen every question of this assessment the maximum number of times.
errors.attempt_in_progress: Exam questions can be challenged only after you submit the attempt.
errors.malformed_xlsx: The spreadsheet was refused: {detail}. Cells with formulas are never evaluated: replace each formula with its plain value (copy, then paste values only) and upload again.
errors.case_group_in_use: This case group still has questions. Move or remove them first.
errors.copy_rejected: Some questions cannot be copied (retired, or they embed images from another course).

editor.hint: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists, tables and $math$. Images come from this course's resources.
editor.displayMath: display math on its own line
editor.notAllowed: Not allowed: headings, links, horizontal rules and raw HTML. The server rejects them.
editor.noImages: This course has no free (non-premium) PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP resources yet. Upload one on the Resources tab.
editor.imagesError: The course resources could not be loaded.
editor.imageRule: Only free image resources of this course can be used (up to 20 per question).

q.caseGroupHint: Questions of one case group are always delivered together, in order, next to the exhibit.

acc.title: Accommodation applied
acc.extra: Your time limit includes {n}% extra time.
acc.untimed: This attempt is untimed for you.
acc.intro: Grant extra time or untimed attempts. A grant for one assessment wins over a global grant; a new grant for the same scope replaces the previous one. Grants apply when an attempt starts.
acc.findUser: Find a learner by name or email
acc.guidRule: Enter a valid ID or leave the field empty.

pause.pausedBody: The questions are hidden while the attempt is paused. Your remaining time is kept; the pause budget is running.

challenge.title: Challenge a question
challenge.body: Explain why you think the question or its answer key is wrong. A reviewer will look at it and you will be notified.
challenge.sent: Challenge sent. You will be notified of the outcome.
challenge.noneMine: You have not challenged any question.
challenge.courseIntro: Challenges learners raised about this course's questions. Reviewers who are not course authors resolve them.
challenge.queueIntro: Resolve challenges: keep the question, send it back for revision, or retire it.
challenge.resolved: Challenge resolved; the learner was notified.

resolutionHint.NoChange: The question is correct as it is.
resolutionHint.Revise: The question needs a revision; the course instructors are notified.

rec.title: Recommendations
rec.noLessons: No lesson recommendations: no weak skills were found.

result.regraded: This attempt was regraded after a correction to the answer key.

practice.title: Practice
practice.subtitle: Build practice sessions from your courses, revise mistakes and review what is due.

builder.title: New practice session
builder.subtitle: Choose what to practise. Leave filters empty to draw from everything available to you.
builder.allCourses: Your enrolled and purchased courses are used.
builder.coursesHint: Leave all unchecked to use every course you are enrolled in.
builder.unseen: Only questions I have not seen
builder.due: Only questions due for spaced review
builder.premiumBody: Questions from premium practice sets are included only while you have an active premium package for that course. Certificate exams are never used for practice.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarked questions
bookmarks.how: Bookmark questions from your spaced review queue; practise them any time.

review.title: Spaced review
review.subtitle: Questions come back when they are due (SM-2). Answer them to grade yourself.
review.noneBody: Answer practice or exam questions; they come back here when they are due.
review.how: Grading: a correct answer counts as "Good" (quality 4), a partly correct one as "Hard" (3) and a wrong one as "Again" (1). Intervals grow 1 day, 6 days, then by your ease factor.
review.graded4: Graded Good (quality 4): the next interval grows.
review.graded3: Graded Hard (quality 3): the interval grows more slowly.
review.graded1: Graded Again (quality 1): it comes back tomorrow.

studio.title: Exam tools
studio.link: Exam tools: case groups, spreadsheet import, reuse, item analytics, challenges, pause policy and certificate design

cases.intro: A case group is a shared exhibit (scenario, table, figure) with several questions that are always delivered together.
cases.noneBody: Create one, then assign questions to it in the question editor.
cases.noResources: No free resources in this course.
cases.deleteBody: Delete "{title}"? This only works when no question uses it.
cases.howToAdd: Assign questions to a case group (and their order) in the question editor.

import.ruleFirstSheet: Only the first worksheet is read; cells are read as stored text.
import.ruleFormula: Cells containing formulas are rejected (cached results are never used). Paste values only.
import.ruleImage: ImageResource: the file name of a free image already uploaded to this course.
import.fileHint: Up to 5 MB and 5000 rows. Macro-enabled and .xls files are refused.
import.mapIntro: {format} file with {n} data rows. Suggested mappings are pre-selected; adjust them as needed. Columns marked * are required.
import.fixErrors: Nothing is imported while any row has errors. Fix the file and start again.
import.queued: Large import queued; progress is shown below.
import.doneBody: {created} created, {updated} updated. Imported questions are drafts and must be reviewed.

reuse.intro: Copy questions from your other courses or from the shared reusable bank. Copies are new drafts with their source recorded, and must be reviewed.
reuse.prefixHint: Added in front of copied external IDs.
reuse.mustReview: Copies are never linked to their source; review them like any new question.

analytics.intro: Classical item statistics from finished attempts. Statistics and option proportions need at least 30 responses.
analytics.noAssessments: This course has no assessments yet.
analytics.insufficient: Insufficient data (<{min}): {n} responses so far. Statistics are hidden until there are enough responses.

policy.allowPauseHint: Learners can pause and resume; the deadline moves by the paused time within the budget.
policy.exposureHint: How many times a learner may see a question across attempts. Leave empty for no limit.
policy.exposureRule: A whole number of 1 or more, or empty.

cert.courseIntro: Choose the certificate design used for this course's PDFs.
cert.intro: Certificate designs used by course PDFs.
cert.noneBody: Create a template to customize certificate PDFs.
cert.name: Name
cert.logoHint: A free PNG or JPEG course resource.
cert.pdfCode: Certificate code for a PDF preview
cert.pdfHint: The PDF uses the template assigned to the certificate's course.

certReq.title: Certificate requests
certReq.correctBody: An approved correction re-issues the certificate with the same code and issue date.
certReq.appealBody: Explain why the certificate should be reinstated.

regrade.proposed: Regrade proposed; a staff member must approve it.
regrade.intro: Approving re-scores every finished attempt that used the question version, without changing answers. Newly passing attempts get certificates; newly failing ones flag certificates for review.
regrade.notOwn: You proposed this regrade; another staff member must decide.
regrade.approveWarning: Approval changes scores of finished attempts and notifies the learners.

flags.intro: Certificates whose evidence attempt no longer passes after a regrade. They are never revoked automatically.

requests.correctionsIntro: Learners asking for a corrected name. Approval re-issues the certificate with the same code.
requests.appealsIntro: Learners appealing a revocation. Approval reinstates the certificate.

reusable.intro: Mark Active questions as reusable so instructors of other courses can copy them (answer keys stay hidden in the shared bank).
reusable.noActive: No Active questions in this course.
reusable.marked: Question added to the reusable bank.
reusable.unmarked: Question removed from the reusable bank.
